Sandbox_Remanescentes_MaxActive: Max survivors with a body at once
Sandbox_Remanescentes_MaxActive_tooltip: How many survivors can be physically present near you at the same time. The rest keep living off-screen.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_NPCHealth_tooltip: Base health. Scaled by archetype (brawler x1.0, shooter x0.85, medic and sneak x0.75) and protective clothing (x1.25). A regular zombie has about 1.0-2.0.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_NPCDamageMultiplie: Multiplies weapon damage dealt by survivors to zombies.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_ZombieDamage_toolt: Health removed from a survivor per zombie attack.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_FriendlyFire_toolt: Only applies to your followers. Other survivors can always be hurt, and that lowers your reputation with their group.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_DebugMenu_tooltip: Shows the 'Remanescentes' right-click menu to spawn and command survivors. Useful for testing.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_ZombieSightRange_t: Tiles at which a zombie can spot a survivor in daylight. Halved at night, reduced when sneaking, increased when running.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_NPCNoiseMultiplier: Scales the noise survivors make when fighting and running (attracts zombies). 0 = silent.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_FleeHealthPercent_: Survivors run away from zombies when their health drops below this. 0 = never flee.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_Barks_tooltip: Short lines when spotting zombies, killing, getting hurt, fleeing and idling.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_ZombieAttackMode_t: Real: zombies use their own attack AI against survivors (experimental). Simulated: lunge animation plus scripted damage.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_NPCVsPlayerDamage: Hostile survivor damage to the player
Sandbox_Remanescentes_NPCVsPlayerDamage_: Multiplies weapon wounds hostile survivors inflict on you. Their hits cut and scratch, never infect.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_WorldGroups_toolti: Total limit of groups (families, militias, raiders...). They appear per region as you explore: more in towns, almost none in the countryside.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_RaiderPercent_tool: Share of new groups that are hostile raiders.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_ScavengeDeathChanc: Chance that an off-screen scavenging trip costs a group member.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_LootLeftPercent_to: Chance each container in a building looted by a group still has its items.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_FortifyHomes_toolt: Group houses get barricades, a locked door, a supply stash, zombie corpses outside and lights at night.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_NPCDifficulty_tool: How much damage they deal to you, how well they shoot and how far they see you.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_RaiderMugging_tool: When they find you, raiders demand your bag and weapon. Complying or leaving avoids the fight.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_CollapsePace_toolt: How fast the world goes from the civilian chaos of the first days to scarcity with raiders. Also counts the game's 'Months since the Apocalypse'.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_RaiderStartDay_too: Before this day of the apocalypse there are no organized raider groups. After it, they grow gradually.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_AmbientDensity_too: Amount of passers-by: civilians walking, fleeing, calling for help. 0 disables. Drops over the days and is lower in the countryside.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_NPCsTurn_tooltip: Bitten survivors get infected and turn hours later; those killed by zombies rise again. Same clothes.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_NPCInfectionChance: Percentage of each zombie hit on a survivor that infects them.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_GroupDensity_toolt: How many groups each town/neighborhood gets. 100 = 1 group per 40 buildings.
Sandbox_Remanescentes_BaseFallRate_toolt: Daily chance of a base being overrun by zombies. Small, poorly fortified groups fall more often. 0 disables.
